title: Machine Learning Enterprise Financial Intelligent Risk Control System Based on New Database
relevance_reason: The paper is primarily about a financial risk control system for enterprises; the Milvus vector database is used merely as a storage/retrieval component without any in-depth examination, comparison, or analysis of vector database technology itself.
research_focus: Designing an intelligent enterprise financial risk control system that predicts enterprise cancellation or revocation risks using the Milvus vector database combined with machine learning algorithms.
method: The system uses the Milvus vector database to store and retrieve high-dimensional feature data, combined with machine learning algorithms including random forest, Euclidean distance, and cosine similarity for risk assessment and prediction.
application_domain: Enterprise financial risk management and investment service technology
results_summary: The paper presents the design of an enterprise financial risk early warning system built on the Milvus vector database and machine learning models. It describes how the system analyzes and predicts two specific risk scenarios: enterprise cancellation and revocation. The authors claim the system enables real-time analysis, continuous monitoring, and scalable processing of large data volumes for risk flagging. However, the provided text (abstract and introduction) does not report specific quantitative results, accuracy metrics, or comparative evaluations of the system's performance.
